definitions.explanation: A sport in which players use clubs to hit a ball into a series of holes on a course.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ゴルフ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My father plays golf on weekends.

examples.japanese: ゴルフ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{接待|せったい}→接待：12903_settai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Golf is often used for business entertainment.

examples.japanese: ゴルフ⟦{場|じょう}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I made a reservation at a golf course.

notes:
From English "golf." Golf is widely popular in Japan, particularly among business professionals and retirees.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ゴルフ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to play golf
- ゴルフ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go golfing
- ゴルフ⟦{場|じょう}→場：03699_ba⟧: golf course
- ゴルフ⟦クラブ→クラブ：10812_kurabu⟧: golf club (both the equipment and the venue)
- ⟦{打|う}ちっ{放|ぱな}し→打ちっ放し：28638_uchippanashi⟧: driving range

CULTURAL NOTE:
⟦{接待|せったい}→接待：12903_settai⟧ゴルフ (business entertainment golf) is a common practice in Japanese corporate culture, where clients or business partners are invited to play golf as a form of relationship building. Golf course memberships (⟦{会員権|かいいんけん}→会員権：noentry⟧) can be very expensive and were historically seen as status symbols.
